out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.'
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS PROVIDED COPY TO PIC DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE REVIEW WITH EMPLOYEES AND HAVE EACH SIGN A COPY. MAINTAIN SIGNED COPIES ON SITE FOR REVIEW BY THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS PROVIDED COPY TO PIC DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE REVIEW WITH EMPLOYEES AND POST FOR USE WHEN NECESSARY.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW LAMB STORED ABOVE LEMONGRASS BROTH AND PREPARED SAUCES IN (4); RAW SHELL EGGS STORED ABOVE COOKED CHICKEN IN (6); RAW BEEF STORED ABOVE COOKED WINGS AND COOKED TENDONS IN (8).
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEES TRAINING AND COMPLIANCE. SAIGON BISTRO (Inspection Date: 10/08/2026) Page 3 of 6

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Equipment food-contact surfaces/utensils were not observed cleaned before any possible contamination. OBSERVED MEAT SLICER WITH ACCUMULATION OF RAW BEEF NOT PROPERLY CLEANED AND SANITIZED FROM USE EARLIER.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned at any time during the operation when contamination may have occurred. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO HAVE EQUIPMENT CLEANED AND SANITIZED AFTER USE. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEES TRAINING AND. COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: BEEF BROTH AT 101F ON STOVE TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO HAVE BROTH REHEATED TO 165F OR ABOVE. BROTH REHEATED TO 202F DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE FOODS IN HOT HOLDING ARE MAINTAINED AT 135F OR ABOVE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: SLICED TOMATOES AT 47F IN (5); COOKED WINGS AT 44F AND CHICKEN BROTH AT 44F IN (8); NOODLES AT 54F, CHILI OIL AT 66F AND HOUSE SAUCE AT 61F ON COUNTER
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC TRANSFERRED COOKED WINGS TO FREEZER FOR RAPID COOLING TO 41F; HOUSE SAUCE DISCARDED AT 4:30PM; ALL OTHER FOODS WERE DISCARDED IMMEDIATELY.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: COOKED CHICKEN, COOKED WINGS, COOKED BEEF, COOKED TENDONS, CHICKEN BROTH IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS WILL CONFIRM COMPLIANCE BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION WITHIN 10 DAYS.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: NOODLES, CHILI OIL AND HOUSE SAUCE ON COUNTER WITHOUT 4 HOUR EXPIRATION TIME INDICATED.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO DISCARD NOODLES AND CHILI OIL IMMEDIATELY; HOUSE SAUCE WAS DISCARDED AT 4:30PM. PLEASE ENSURE TPHC PROCEDURES ARE PROPERLY MAINTAINED.

violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO CREATE TABLE TENTS OR TABLE PLACARDS FOR OCCASIONS WHEN “AMUSE BOUCHE” IS SERVED WITH RAW OR UNDERCOOKED ANIMAL PROTEINS. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION. SAIGON BISTRO (Inspection Date: 10/08/2026) Page 4 of 6

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: RAW SHRIMP AT 59F THAWING IN 3 COMPARTMENT SINK IN STANDING WATER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REMOVE SHRIMP AND TRANSFER TO FREEZER FOR RAPID COOLING TO 41F OR BELOW DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEES TRAINING AND. COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: GRILLED CHICKEN AT 81F AFTER 3 HOURS IN DEEP COVERED CONTAINER IN AVANTCO 3 DOOR FLAT TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE FOODS ARE COOLED IN SHALLOW UNCOVERED PANS. USE SMALLER PORTIONS IN FREEZER TO RAPIDLY COOL FOODS TO THE PROPER COOLING PARAMETERS.

EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO OPEN FAUCET TO ALLOW FROZEN SQUID TO THAW UNDER RUNNING WATER. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: RICE SCOOP STORED IN WATER AT 79F; KNIVES STORED BETWEEN PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REMOVE UTENSILS FOR CLEANING AND SANITIZING AND TO STORE ON DRY, CLEAN, SANITIZED SURFACES. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS WILL EMAIL HANDWASHING SIGNAGE TO PIC. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASH SIGNAGE IS POSTED AT ALL HANDWASHING SINKS.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW CHICKEN STORED ABOVE COOKED BEEF IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EMPLOYEE REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: FOOD PANS AND DISHES BEING SANITIZED IN DISHWASHING MACHINE IN KITCHEN. SANITIZER MEASURED AT 0PPM AT END OF CYCLE.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO HAVE DISHES SANITIZED IN 3 COMPARTMENT SINK BEFORE PLACING TO AIR DRY.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. OBSERVED BEEF BROTH AT 47-50F IN DEEP COVERED CONTAINERS IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR PREPARED THE PREVIOUS DAY.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD CONTAINERS OF BROTH DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: FRIED ONIONS AT 66F, THAI SAUCE AT 66F, CHILI SAUCE AT 68F, SHRIMP SPRING ROLLS AT 61F ON EXPO COUNTER; FRESH GARLIC IN OIL AT 61F; FRIED GARLIC AT 70F, UNSALTED BUTTER AT 71F ON CART NEAR COOK LINE; NOODLES AT 61F ON COUNTE; FRIED ONIONS AT 66F AND FRIED GARLIC AT 61F IN CONTAINERS PREPARED 2 DAYS PRIOR IN DRY STORAGE ROOM.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD FRIED ONIONS AND FRIED GARLIC. ALL OTHER FOODS WERE PLACED ON TIME TO BE DISCARDED AT 3:00PM. EHS WILL FORWARD TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL DOCUMENTATION TO PIC.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: BEEF BROTHS, SOUPS, VARIOUS COOKED BEEF, SAUCES IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE ALL FOODS HELD FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS ARE APPROPRIATELY DATE MARKED AND UNUSED PORTIONS DISCARDED AFTER 7 DAYS.. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: BEEF BROTH AT 47-50F IN DEEP COVERED CONTAINERS PREPARED THE PREVIOUS DAY; COOKED CHICKEN AT 74-89F FOR 1.5 HOURS IN DEEP COVERED CONTAINERS IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR .
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD BEEF BROTH DURING INSPECTION. COOKED CHICKEN WERE PLACED ON TRAYS AND TRANSFERRED TO FREEZER FOR RAPID COOLING. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE TO SET UP SANITIZING BUCKETS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: DISHWASHING MACHINE IN KITCHEN UNABLE TO DISPENSE SANITIZER AT 50-200 PPM.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE REPAIR DISHWASHING MACHINE AND USE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK FOR SANITIZING DISHES UNTIL REPAIRED AND CAN SANITIZE AT 50-200 PPM.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system: CONNECTED TO ICE MACHINE IN BAR.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE INSTALL AN APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE ON ICE MACHINE (IN BAR) CONNECTED TO WATER SUPPLY LINE.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours. BEEF BONE BROTH AT 96F ON COOKER AND CHICKEN KEBAB AT 96-101F IN MOTAK 3 DOOR PREP TOPS JUST UNDER 2 HOURS.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REHEAT FOODS TO 165F OR ABOVE. SAIGON BISTRO (Inspection Date: 04/25/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: FRIED ONIONS AT 73F PREPARED THE DAY BEFORE IN STORAGE BIN UNDER COUNTER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD FRIED ONIONS DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure STATEMENT FOR: EYE OF ROUND STEAK, PHO - HOUSE SPECIAL, BONE IN SHORT RIB, STEAK PHO.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE UPDATE WITHIN 10 DAYS.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Restricted, commercial use pesticides present in the facility are applied by the operator who is not a certified pesticide applicator. OBSERVED COMBAT BAIT DISCS LOCATED IN BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. REMOVE FROM FACILITY AND PROVIDE ONLY CERTIFIED PEST CONTROL SERVICE.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: CHICKEN KEBAB AT 96-101F STACKED IN COVERED CONTAINER IN PREP TOP; BEEF BROTH AT 96F IN LARGE STOCK POT.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE USE APPROPRIATE METHODS TO COOL FOODS TO THE PROPER COOLING METHODS. ADDITIONAL GUIDANCE MATERIALS WIL BE EMAILED TO PIC.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED MICE DROPPINGS IN BACK STORAGE AREA NEAR KITCHEN BACK DOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. CLEAN AND PROVIDE CERTIFIED PEST CONTROL SERVICE WITHIN 10 DAYS.

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the TOP AND BOTTOM OF KITCHEN BACK DOOR; CEILING IN BACK STORAGE AREA NEAR KITCHEN BACK DOOR; CEILING AREA ABOVE WATER HEATER.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system: CONNECTED TO BAR ICE MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14.
